jobs.tierReason: owner rule: one Opus review of the combined release diff
jobs.prompt:
Review release train 5 of Project Swarm: branch swarm/train5 against main at 0aef30bc (1.167.28). The combined code diff is in context at coordination/review/train5.diff; the full workspace is present, so open any file you need.

What changed:
(1) KILL PATHS, tools/concurrency-guard.mjs and tools/stress-tests.mjs: the guarded child is spawned in its own process group; the wrapper and watcher signal the whole group (child-pid fallback) after the start-time + command-line identity check; the watcher escalates once to SIGKILL; stress rounds stop on Ctrl-C (group kill, exit 130) or SIGTERM (143).
(2) LEDGER, tools/tickets.mjs and tools/scope-commands.mjs: bulk supersede writes once under the scope lock from the fresh ledger; superseded tickets are pruned from dependents' dependsOn and the prune is logged; the approval hash ignores superseded tickets; renderBuildPlan uses the same live set as ledgerStats; last-touch reads id/ticket/ids/tickets log shapes and skips corrupt log lines.
(3) OWNER CHECK: one gate for the bulk supersede and `tickets --set superseded`; refuses Claude/Codex/Cursor agent/worker sessions and non-TTY callers unless SWARM_OWNER=1.
(4) MERGE GATE v2, tools/merge-guard.mjs: a release PR needs a committed review-run record (coordination/review/<train>-review-run.json) at the PR head, a metadata-only commit whose parent is the reviewed code head. The record carries train, runId, agent claude, an opus model, verdict pass, the full 40-char head, resultFile and its sha256, manifest and at. The gate fetches the record, the head commit parents and the compare from GitHub, requires the compare to touch only the record and the result file, verifies the result hash and the result verdict/head, and refuses before any `gh pr merge`. Reviews parsing is fence-aware; the release-title regex accepts case/whitespace and 'Release X.Y.Z'.
(5) D-fix batches 27a (scope-commands) and 27b (server-restart): logging-only silent-catch visibility.

Pass bar (owner): blockers only. Look hard at: a way a release PR can pass the gate without a genuine committed review-run record for the full current head (or a record commit that also changes code); a process group kill that reaches an innocent process or misses the guarded descendants; a ledger lost update, a superseded dependency left blocking, or an approval lapse; an owner-only bypass; a crash/hang on a normal path; a test weakened/skipped; money/key leakage. Everything else is a follow-up.

IMPORTANT for the review record: write the review JSON with a `head` field equal to the FULL 40-character SHA the review ran against (`git rev-parse HEAD` in your workspace). The orchestrator seat will build the committed run record from this result and the run state.

Write ONLY coordination/review/train5-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"head":"<full 40-char sha>","blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail only if blockers is non-empty.
